notes.title: Project Tower Gameplay Livestream at Steam Next Fest! 🎮
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Our Project Tower livestream is now live as part of Steam Next Fest! 🚀 

Project Tower is a sci-fi action game where you use unique transformation abilities to overcome challenges and battle enemies.

Tune in now, watch the gameplay, and don’t forget to try the demo while it’s available!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2242970/Project_Tower/

notes.title: Celebrating 20,000 Wishlists for Project Tower on Steam! 🤖
notes.content:
Hello Steam Community!

We are excited to share some fantastic news with you all: Project Tower has reached 20,000 wishlists on Steam! 🚀 

This is a huge milestone for us, and we couldn't have achieved it without your incredible support.

Thank you to everyone who has added our game to their wishlist and helped spread the word. Let's keep this momentum going as we continue our journey together. A big thank you also to all those who have already tested the demo. Your feedback is invaluable!


If you haven't already, check out Project Tower and add it to your wishlist here: 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2242970/Project_Tower/


Your support means everything to us. Stay tuned for more exciting updates! ⭐

Best regards,
Project Tower Team

notes.title: Project Tower Demo Update Now Live! 🚀
notes.content:
Dear Project Tower Community,


This update introduces numerous improvements and new features, all made possible by your invaluable feedback.


Update Highlights:

    🔧 Keyboard Bug Fixes: No more issues with keyboard keys – enjoy a smoother gaming experience!

    🖱️ Keybinding for Keyboard: Customize your controls with our new keybinding feature.

    🎥 Camera Adjustment: The camera has been moved back slightly for better visibility and gameplay.

    🔍 Minor Corrections: Fixed display bug concerning floor numbers / Improved translations for better localization / Enhanced optimization for smoother performance.


Your feedback has been instrumental in helping us improve the game. We are grateful for your continued support and the time you’ve taken to share your thoughts with us. These changes are a direct result of your input, and we’re committed to making Project Tower the best experience it can be.

Try the updated demo now: [Demo Link] 🎮

Thank you for being an essential part of our community. We look forward to hearing more of your feedback and continuing this journey together.

Call to Action:

Don't forget to add Project Tower to your Steam wishlist if you haven't already! ⭐ 
For those who have already tested the demo, don't hesitate to fill out the survey that we prepared for the demo. We would be delighted to have your feedback. 📝

[Participate in the survey]

Thank you for being part of our journey. Enjoy the updated demo! 🎉


Warm regards,

The Yummy Games Team
